data.summary: Gasversorgung Beispielhain GmbH informs Nele Musterkamp that, from 1 May 2025, the prices for the "Beispielhain Gas Komfort" gas tariff will rise, increasing the monthly advance payment (Abschlag) from €89.00 to €97.00.
data.explanation: Your gas provider is raising its prices (working price and base fee) from the date shown, citing higher gas storage and network costs. You don't need to do anything if you accept the new prices; they will simply apply automatically. If you don't agree, German law gives you a special right to cancel the contract without the normal notice period (Sonderkündigungsrecht) before the price change takes effect — the app will show you until when this right lasts. If you want to keep the contract, no action is needed.
